title: jammy Peruvian potatoes stew
description: A delicious and comforting Peruvian-style stew featuring juicy potatoes, sweet raisins, and a hint of smoky spices, perfect for a cold evening or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: preferably a mix of yellow and purple varieties

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the potatoes, raisins, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C).
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the liquid has thickened into a rich sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Let the stew rest for 10-15 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
